patch_description: Replace the current (lower-scoring) flat ANSATZ_SPEC with the modular block-based construction from the best-performing prior candidate (0.89 score), and apply the recommended refinement: give each of the two repeated blocks its own ring-entanglement parameters (`crz_ring_even_b0`/`crz_ring_odd_b0` for block 1, `crz_ring_even_b1`/`crz_ring_odd_b1` for block 2) while keeping skip-2, skip-3, and diameter CRZ parameters fully shared across both blocks. This restores the higher-performing modular architecture (RY→ring CRZ→RX→skip2/skip3/diameter CRZ) and adds a small amount of block-local flexibility to the nearest-neighbor entangling layer, which is the most position-sensitive part of the circuit, while preserving the regularization benefit of parameter sharing everywhere else. This should recover the ~0.89-0.90 accuracy level while potentially improving further via the extra local expressivity.
